candidates.title: Internship in GenAI Knowledge Assistant for Engineering at Bosch
candidates.description: Company Description At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Join in and feel the difference. TheBosch Home Comfort Group is looking forward to your application! Job Description During your assignment, you will collect, structure and preprocess engineering knowledge sources such as technical documents, specifications, test reports and structured datasets. You will evaluate suitable Databricks-native and open-source tools (e.g. RAG, Text-to-SQL, AI Agents, Vector Search, Genie) for different types of engineering content. Based on this, you will design and implement natural language workflows on Databricks that allow hardware engineers to query both documents and structured data. To deliver reliable, source-grounded answers, you will apply prompt and context engineering and ensure result quality and traceability (e.g. citations, evaluation, guardrails). Additionally, you will collaborate closely with hardware engineers to understand use cases and iteratively improve the solution. Finally, you will communicate progress and findings through visualizations, short presentations and technical documentation. Qualifications Education: master studies in the field of Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a comparable quantitative or tech
